vulnerabilityAlerts.description: The only additions to Renovate's built-in security defaults. A label makes these PRs sortable, and `osvVulnerabilityAlerts` above sources advisories from osv.dev as well as GitHub's own feed. `minimumReleaseAge` overrides Renovate's default of none for security fixes: pnpm-workspace.yaml sets `minimumReleaseAgeStrict`, so a fix less than a day old would fail its lockfile update. Waiting the day opens a PR that installs, not one that is red for a reason CI cannot fix.

packageRules.description: Bump devDependency ranges eagerly: nothing downstream consumes them, so a raised floor costs nobody anything and keeps the lockfile honest about what CI actually ran.

Never narrow what consumers can satisfy. `dependencies` keep their published range until a release falls outside it, and peer ranges only ever widen — this is a library, so a bumped floor here is a breaking change for downstreams.

Mirror `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` in pnpm-workspace.yaml. These are our own publishes, so the day's wait that lets someone else catch a compromised release buys nothing. Keep the two lists in step: a package excluded there but held here waits a day for no reason, and the reverse opens a PR whose install fails.

Group the oxlint / oxfmt toolchain. `oxlint-tsgolint` belongs here rather than with TypeScript despite its 7.0.x version: it is oxlint's type-aware backend and is released against oxlint, not against the compiler.

Group the TypeDoc docs toolchain. These live in the tools/api-docs workspace package rather than the root manifest; Renovate reads every workspace package.json, so the group keeps matching them there.

Hold tools/api-docs on TypeScript 6. That package exists precisely because TypeScript 7 is the native Go compiler and ships no JavaScript compiler API for TypeDoc to import — see tools/api-docs/README.md. Letting the devDependencies rule above bump this to 7 would re-break `docs:api` in a dependency PR far from the reasoning that caused it. Lift this the day TypeDoc supports 7, not before.

Same reason, different consumer: `typescript-6` is an alias of typescript@6 that scripts/raw-xml-ratchet.mjs imports because it walks a syntax tree, which TypeScript 7 cannot do. Held below 7 independently of the tools/api-docs pin above — the two unwind separately.
Keep temml + mathml2omml (the optional /math peer deps) in lockstep.
Pin GitHub Actions to commit SHAs and batch their updates.
